Uncle Vanya at the Vivian Beaumont was worth every penny, and even though the story itself is vaguely defined, the passion and the dissonance and its place in the world of art is undeniable, and as triumphant and glorious as any opera I’ve ever seen in the exquisite building a stone’s throw away.

While Lila Neugebauer’s revival of Uncle Vanya in the new Heidi Schreck version is always easy to understand, it does the play a disservice in reducing it to its lowest terms.
